text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having successfully weathered those crucial first three years,
she went on to leave her mark in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for the two of them, today—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "To achieve my long-held goal of becoming a 'world-renowned, legendary Umamusume.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was about to take her first step toward challenging overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Have a safe trip, Kura-chan...!
Take care.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"While you're away, I'll make sure to
keep the Twinkle Series super hype,
so leave it to me!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how reassuring!
As expected of our "Festival Girl"!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And—hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even after you come back home, Kura-chan!
I'm not giving up center stage at the festival!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Sounds good, I'll take it to heart.
...Whether it actually happens is another story, though!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I, too, within this year.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The next Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, for sure...
...I will definitely run in it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And so, I will show them.
What true "strength" really is.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Crown. No matter how brightly you polish that crown of yours—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I will seize a victory so brilliant it leaves all else in a haze, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that sounds tough.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still, Duramente-san.
If I can compete against you once more,
I would be truly delighted.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's clash again and again to decide
who is truly the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I... from me...
U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...H-Have a safe trip.
Take... good care of yourself."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: And also, ...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Next time, I'll show them a real challenge.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you will shine on the world stage too.
But... so will I.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"E-Even I will... By the time you return...
I'll become a great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Without fail.
Someone like you, who's going to take on the world—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'll become someone who wants to take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Cheval, what an intense look in your eyes.
It sent shivers down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm looking forward to it.
—Including the day I finally defeat you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "No matter how much fighting spirit was directed at her, she took it head-on and deflected it back. With that, she finished greeting her rivals."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, we'd better head through security soon. As sad as it is to leave...
choice_data_list: Huh... come to think of it, Dia didn't come?
Huh... Speaking of which, where is Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes. She told me yesterday at the dorm, 'I won't be coming to see you off.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"She told me, 'I will focus on what I need to do.'
'Because that is the greatest encouragement I can give.'
...Hehe, she's as dependable as ever."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the whole time we were talking,
she kinda kept looking down, so—”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'd wager a big part of it is that she's
afraid she'll get lonely once you actually get there♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I'll have to give my cute little protégé
a long call once I get there."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say 'not at all'—I'm not that heartless.
...Though I can't get sentimental enough to say
'I miss them terribly!' either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Because it's so exciting! No matter how you look at it!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you the same way?
It's written all over your face.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, but isn't it exciting!?
Hong Kong, France, Dubai!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll go challenge anyone, anywhere!
I'm not gonna lose to any girl!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Even if our opponent is a world-renowned Umamusume!
No matter how cornered we might be!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Together, you and I—
Let's turn everything upside down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No matter how grand the victory!
We will seize it with our own two hands!
